env_allowlist.HOME: worker-provided pinned Elan toolchain root; replaced with an empty temporary home for Lean replay

recipes.network_enforcement: The validator locates the already installed pinned toolchain explicitly, fixes LEAN_PATH to pre-existing compiled roots, and runs every Lean process under Bubblewrap with a read-only host root, a disposable writable replay tree, and --unshare-net. It reads the pinned manifest as data but does not invoke Lake manifest resolution or mutate .lake.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact eight-line PASS/FAIL-CLOSED summary and per-stage output SHA-256 values bound by validation-receipt.json

recipes.scope_boundary: Network-isolated, trust-zero, fresh-output replay against pinned warm dependency artifacts. Covered IDs identify provisional proof/trust observations, not accepted closure. Proof acceptance, frozen graph/provenance reconciliation, complete foundation/TCB/SBOM closure, clean-checkout empty-cache offline replay, and distinct signed independent verification remain fail-closed.
